title: Hearty Herbal Italian Fish Pasta
description: A fresh and bouncy Italian pasta dish featuring pecorino and miso-marinated fish, perfect for a pescatarian-friendly brunch
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the linguine pasta according to package instructions until al dente
In a small bowl, whisk together miso paste and 2 tbsp of olive oil to make the marinade
Place the cod fillets in a shallow dish and brush the miso marinade on both sides of the fish
Let the fish marinate for 10 minutes
Heat the remaining olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the garlic until fragrant
Add the marinated fish to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through
Remove the fish from the skillet and set aside
Add the chopped parsley and basil to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until wilted
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the herb mixture
Serve the pasta hot, topped with the cooked fish and grated pecorino cheese
